birth_input_comparison.dynamics_semantics: In the reviewed overdamped spherical model, GPU trial and batch prefix derive free velocity and half-curl from the current position, solve instantaneous resistance/contact, and overwrite stored v/omega. Stored birth omega is not an inertial input to the next position update.
birth_input_comparison.interpretation: Birth velocity and angular velocity are field-derived under the unchanged admission rule. Matching translation does not imply matching curl-derived rotation; the birth omega difference is not an independent explanation for subsequent path differences.

caveat: Original boundary triangle geometry is preserved. Volume connectivity changes beyond the refinement spheres; eliminating exact-zero cells does not establish local accuracy or trajectory convergence.
